R4.passage: People wear hats to look good, and they wear hats for other reasons too. Siberia is in the north of Russia, where winter is long and very cold. People there wear fur hats, because fur is very warm and it stops the cold wind. Cuba is hot and sunny all year, so people wear Panama hats. The Panama hat is light and it has a wide brim. It protects the head from the sun and it keeps people cool, which is important when the temperature is high. In Vietnam many people wear a non la hat. It is wide and light, and it keeps people dry in the heavy rain. So the same idea, a hat, does three different jobs: it keeps you warm, it keeps you cool, and it keeps you dry.

additions: Contractions are the core of this unit: accept i'm / i am, he's / he is, she's / she is, they're / they are, isn't / is not, aren't / are not.
